# Claude Chat Mobile
> Self-hosted mobile web UI for Claude Code: a phone UI that drives your own terminal `claude` CLI via the Agent SDK. Same session, same host settings; touch layout, not a screen mirror. Works with any gateway or API key the CLI is already configured for. Single-driver; single-user (n=1) self-hosted architecture.

## Try It / See It
- [Live Demo](https://ccm.osolee.cc.cd/demo/): The real product frontend, driven by an in-browser fake backend. No install, no server, no network calls (CSP `connect-src 'none'`).
- [Architecture Diagrams](https://ccm.osolee.cc.cd/diagrams/): 13 interactive diagrams — dual-channel sync, single-driver lock, auth gates, approval lifecycle, push suppression, test placement.
